title: Air Force Heavy Press Program (USAF film) by D.O.D.
summary: A US Air Force film on the Heavy Press Program, which built some of the world's largest metal forging and extrusion presses for aircraft, starting from German presses taken after WWII.
why: Cited as historical precedent for large government industrial investment and for modern gigacasting.

quote.text: the Heavy Press Program brought industrial metal presses out of Germany and into the United States and Russia.
